column1: # Canonical bounded LogicalDataSource table/index scan-task runtime.

column5: TopN then CMSketch then histogram precedence remains the admitted equality adapter for index paths; general encoded-key estimation stays external.
Index CountAfterAccess and table CountAfterAccess are explicit source inputs; arbitrary range cardinality derivation remains external.
Finite nonnegative source CountAfterAccess reaches the chosen index or table physical scan; general datasource statistics derivation remains external.
Existing index scan cost choice is preserved; table/index or multiple-table candidate sets reject until their shared cost tree is ported.

Empty ranges return TableDual before construction; one admitted TiKV table path becomes a root TableReader while PointGet, TiFlash, partition, sample, filters, ordering, mixed candidates, limited ExpectedCnt, and unsupported task shapes fail closed.
LogicalDataSource routes represented access paths through one bounded scan-read authority; expression, schema, ranger, partition pruning, and broad candidate enumeration remain external.
The unified task sum carries an index Cop task, root TableReader, zero-row TableDual, or explicit rejection; other source task variants remain external.
CopTableTask converts its owned table scan through the table-only root conversion branch; network cost, virtual-column projection, root filters, index readers, and lookup readers remain external.

The selected table access path constructs one physical TiKV table scan with exact plan identity, query offset, finite source row count, and pre-resolved pushdown metadata; range construction and schema/default resolution remain external.

The reader owns the actual selected table scan, uses its plan ID for cloned flattened-child identity, and preserves existing request/explain/clone metadata; executor and RPC construction remain external.
The bounded table path accepts only Root with no ordering and unbounded ExpectedCnt; full property matching, enforcers, MPP partitions, and limit adjustment remain external.
Typed table/index access paths preserve upstream point-range admission, empty-range state, storage, table-only flags, and resolved scan input; ranger values and expression extraction remain external.
